description: Refactor NewsPipelineService (1903 lines, 6+ responsibilities) into 5 focused services following Single Responsibility Principle
approach: Extract cohesive method groups into dedicated services: ArticleFetchService (crawling and caching), ArticleCleaningService (LLM processing), SummaryDedupeService (embedding and deduplication), MongoOutboxService (outbox pattern implementation), and NewsPipelineOrchestrator (coordination only). Each service handles a single domain concern.

Extract cache-related methods: cacheKey, getCrawlLockTtlMs
Inject dependencies: Crawl4aiClient, CacheService, PrismaService, NewsPipelineConfigService

Export service from module
